title: Crash on startup when config.yaml is missing optional 'cache' key
body:
Steps to reproduce:
1. Remove the `cache:` key from config.yaml
2. Run `myapp --config config.yaml`
3. Observe the traceback below

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "myapp/config.py", line 42, in load_config
    cache_ttl = config['cache']['ttl']
KeyError: 'cache'

Expected: cache should default to disabled when the key is absent, per docs/config.md. Happens on v2.3.1, Python 3.11, macOS 14.
